name: Console Lobby
description: Lev Fer's site: an early-2000s console game menu in space, built to be the one link in his bio. Home, tour dates, clips, podcast, blog, forum, chat room and mailing list as menu items.

settings.label: Home screen
settings.help: What people see first, usually after tapping the link in your bio. Turn sections on or off and put them in the order you want.

settings.label: Home screen sections
options: Your photo, name, tagline and the first line of your bio. Photo comes from People.
Big buttons for everything in Links (your special, merch, anything). Add them under Site extras → Links.
Patreon, Ko-fi or Substack. Set the link in Profile.
The posts you pin under Site extras → Home screen. The first one is big.
Your next few dates with ticket buttons.
Podcasts you're on, with the latest episode. Shows up by itself for any ComicTable podcast you're part of.
The video you starred in Videos, like a special.
A button to join your fan list.
Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and the rest from People.

settings.label: How many shows on the Home screen
Menu
settings.help: Home is always first. A section only shows when it has something in it (no blog posts yet, no Blog).

settings.label: Menu order
options: Approved photos and bio for clubs, from your press kit.
Your Patreon (or other support link) as a menu item.

settings.label: Highlight color
settings.help: The selected menu bar and the big buttons.

settings.label: Show loading-screen jokes
settings.help: The rotating "Tip:" lines at the top.

settings.label: Your loading-screen jokes
settings.help: One per line. "Tip:" is added for you. Leave it empty to use the ones the design comes with.
settings.placeholder:
Lev cannot be dual-wielded.
Heckling does not make you respawn faster.
